prompt:

Asset type: transparent hero artwork for an actual mobile game splash screen, LobsOfLove.
Input image 1 is the approved concept to evolve. Preserve its central idea and recognizable form: an open clear jewel case containing a miniature tennis court, fine net, yellow ball, two amber score windows and a round button. Remove all typography outside the object.
Give this object a distinct handcrafted stop-motion / painted miniature art style. A lovingly built strange little tennis world, collectible 1990s Japanese toy design meets hand-painted architectural maquette. Keep crystal clear rounded molded shell and articulated open lid, but make the interior frame rich dark pine-green enamel with subtle brush marks, the court muted sage flocking with chalky ivory accurate tennis lines. Small warm orange enamel hinge details and buttery yellow button, aged silver net posts, intricate real mesh, one slightly oversized fuzzy yellow tennis ball poised in air above the net. Score windows both read "00", a tiny embossed "LOL" on front corner. Warm honey highlights on the clear lid, cool green shadows, gently imperfect hand-painted edge wear, tactile soft microtextures, exquisite believable material transitions. Charming and surreal, deliberately authored, never grungy, not glossy generic product advertising. Three-quarter view same orientation as reference, camera a little more orthographic, entire object including fully open lid in frame with 10 percent safe padding on every edge. Hero object is the sole subject. Subtle ambient contact shading on object itself, no backdrop or floor plane. Transparent background with true alpha. No surrounding words, no UI, no hearts, no pink, no motion streaks, no plants or characters, no additional floating objects. Highest-quality finished miniature illustration ready to composite over warm paper. Square 1536x1536 composition.
